title: agrostis ramulosa
intro: Agrostis ramulosa, commonly known as needlegrass or bent grass, is a type of grass native to mountainous regions of the world. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis ramulosa include its ability to act as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent, making it effective in treating wounds and skin infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
